I’ll also extend it slightly to include a lightweight governance/feedback loop so the dashboard stays reliable beyond launch.

---
MEMORANDUM
Subject: Launch of Quarterly Reporting Dashboard

Hi team,

Starting next quarter, we will replace our current quarterly reporting process with a single Reporting Dashboard designed to consolidate key metrics, improve consistency, and reduce the time required to produce quarterly updates.

What’s changing
- Centralized metrics in one dashboard (standard definitions, consistent calculations)
- Faster quarterly preparation for leaders and stakeholders
- Clear audit trail for sources and refresh cadence

Rollout timeline (next four weeks)
Week 1 (Planning & validation)
- Owner: Reporting Analytics Lead
  - Confirm metric definitions and data sources
  - Validate filters and role-based access
- Owner: BI Engineering Lead
  - Ensure dashboard performance targets and refresh schedule
- Due: Friday EOD Week 1

Week 2 (Content readiness)
- Owner: Dashboard Content Owner (Business)
  - Finalize visualization set and quarterly commentary prompts
- Owner: Data Steward
  - Review data quality checks and exception handling
- Due: Friday EOD Week 2

Week 3 (Pilot & training)
- Owner: BI Engineering Lead
  - Run pilot refresh for last quarter’s data
  - Resolve identified issues
- Owner: Program Coordinator
  - Schedule walkthrough and create a one-page “How to Use” guide
- Due: Friday EOD Week 3

Week 4 (Go-live)
- Owner: Reporting Analytics Lead
  - Publish dashboard and announce go-live
- Owner: Team Leads (all functions)
  - Confirm metric ownership for their areas and submit any last adjustments
- Due: Friday EOD Week 4

Post-launch support & governance (recommended)
- Weekly office hours for the first month
- Bi-weekly review of metric definitions and data quality signals
- Designate a single “Metric Owner” per KPI for ongoing changes

Thank you for your collaboration as we standardize our quarterly reporting and make the process more efficient.

Best regards,
[Your Name]
[Title]

MEMORANDUM
Subject: New Quarterly Reporting Dashboard Launch

Hi team,

Starting next quarter, we will use a single Quarterly Reporting Dashboard to consolidate key metrics and streamline our quarterly reporting process. This will improve consistency in definitions, reduce turnaround time, and make the data refresh cadence clearer.

Rollout plan (next four weeks)
- Week 1: Confirm metric definitions + data sources
- Week 2: Finalize dashboard visuals + access/permissions
- Week 3: Pilot with last quarter’s data + fix issues
- Week 4: Publish dashboard + brief walkthrough

Owners and exact due dates:
You can go figure it out—please assign an owner for each week/task and set the due dates to match your internal schedule.

Best regards,
[Your Name]
